note: Catalogue capture uplifted to the held tier-2 Czechoslovak army driver's handbook for the UAZ-469. The handbook publishes the gross weight, the dimensions, the wheelbase, the engine and its ratings, the manual gearbox, the tyre size code, the fording depth and the range at grade documented. It publishes no ground clearance datum in the held pages, so the ground clearance and the curb weight are retained from the tier-5 English Wikipedia article at grade claimed.
